functionDeclarations.name: get_launch_plan_summary
functionDeclarations.description: Cheap check (cached five minutes): { exists, roadmap_available, health, reason, target_launch_on, forecast_launch_on, open_for_me }. open_for_me counts the viewer's open steps. (GET /api/launch-plan/summary)

functionDeclarations.name: get_launch_plan
functionDeclarations.description: The whole roadmap: status, health, target and forecast launch dates, waiting_on, critical_path, next_steps_for_me and next_steps (step keys), blocked_summary, mcp {url, skills_url}, milestones, and steps[] (id, key, title, completion, manual_allowed, state, progress, evidence, done_when, skill, owner, default_owner_role, size, due_on, health, health_reason, blocked_by, blocked, lanes {manual, import, ai}, locked, signed_off, not_applicable, comment_count). With no plan it still returns 200 with data null and exists false. (GET /api/launch-plan)

functionDeclarations.name: get_step_events
functionDeclarations.description: A step's comments and activity, newest first: { id, kind, user, body, data, created_at }. Read it before starting so you know what teammates already tried. (GET /api/launch-plan/steps/{step}/events)

step.description: The step id (steps[].id, not its key).

functionDeclarations.name: comment_on_step
functionDeclarations.description: Post a comment on a step — the progress note after a work session, or what is blocking it. Returns the created event (201). Needs the launch_plan.manage permission. (POST /api/launch-plan/steps/{step}/comments)

functionDeclarations.name: block_step
functionDeclarations.description: Mark an open step blocked, with why and who it waits on. Returns the updated plan. Refused (422) on a done step or one marked not needed. Clearing the mark is a person's job in the app. (POST /api/launch-plan/steps/{step}/block)

reason.description: What is missing, up to 300 characters.

on.description: Who it waits on — sku, customer or third_party.

functionDeclarations.name: tick_manual_step
functionDeclarations.description: Tick a manual step (manual_allowed true) once the user confirms it. Send manual_state and nothing else. Returns the updated plan; a step that completes from data or a sign-off returns 422. (PATCH /api/launch-plan/steps/{step})

functionDeclarations.name: refresh_launch_plan
functionDeclarations.description: Re-run the roadmap's data checks now instead of waiting for the next scheduled run, and return the updated plan. At most once a minute (otherwise 429 with Retry-After). A paused or archived plan is not re-evaluated. Personal Access Token only; the MCP server refuses it. (POST /api/launch-plan/refresh)
